# Educational App Store

> A trusted platform providing certified reviews and recommendations of educational apps across iOS, Android, and iPad for teachers, parents, and students.

Educational App Store curates and reviews 50+ app categories spanning core subjects, assistive technology, AI-powered learning tools, and interactive games. The platform serves educators, parents, and learners seeking evidence-based app recommendations aligned with educational standards.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered learning tools
- Assistive technology
- Reading and phonics apps
- Special education support
- Grammar and spelling apps
- Language learning apps
- Math and times tables apps
- Brain training and word games
- Educational games
- iOS and Android apps
- iPad learning apps
- Teacher productivity tools
- Student writing tools
- AAC communication apps
- Dyslexia and autism support

## Core Navigation

- [Educational App Store Homepage](https://www.educationalappstore.com): Homepage showcasing certified app reviews for teachers, parents, and students.
- [App Categories](https://www.educationalappstore.com/app): Browse 50+ app categories across subjects, user roles, and learning tools.

## AI Tools for Learning

- [AI Apps for Kids](https://www.educationalappstore.com/best-apps/ai-apps-for-kids): Guide to AI-powered apps for personalized child learning experiences.
- [AI Tools for Teachers](https://www.educationalappstore.com/best-apps/ai-tools-for-teachers): Review of AI tools like Chalkie and MagicSchool for lesson planning and grading.
- [AI Tools for Students](https://www.educationalappstore.com/best-apps/ai-tools-for-students): Exploration of AI tools like ChatGPT for student productivity and academic writing.
- [AI Grading Tools](https://www.educationalappstore.com/best-apps/ai-grading-tools): Review of 9 AI grading tools including Gradescope for automated assessment.

- [Language Learning Apps](https://www.educationalappstore.com/app-lists/language-learning-apps): Language learning apps like Busuu and Promova for skill development.
- [Word Game Apps](https://www.educationalappstore.com/best-apps/word-game-apps): Word game apps like Wordscapes for vocabulary and language skills.

## Math & Cognitive Development
